query: Last weekend I took my golden retriever to the new off-leash dog park near the community center, and he had so much fun chasing after a frisbee with a bunch of other pups that he ended up falling asleep in the car on the way home before I even got his leash unclipped. I also tried that new matcha latte spot downtown on Monday, and their lavender honey topping is so good I’ve already gone back twice this week to get another one, I swear it’s the best iced drink I’ve had all summer. Oh, and I just finished rearranging the succulent planters on my balcony yesterday, I moved the string of pearls to get more sun and it already looks way perkier than it did when it was tucked in the corner. I’m having some issues with my phone right now: wifi calling is really bad, my APN MMS settings seem to be broken, both of my messaging app permissions aren’t working, my data mode is turned off, I’ve exceeded my data usage limit, I’m currently abroad and roaming is switched off so I can’t get any of my mobile services to work properly.
